requirements.requirement: The system must produce identical composite scores for the same clinical trial input across multiple executions (determinism test).
The system must verify that all configured scoring weights are applied exactly as defined in the scoring schema during score computation.
The system must validate that the composite score equals the weighted aggregation of all normalized measure inputs.
The system must confirm that normalization functions produce values within the expected bounded range for each measure.
The system must successfully compute scores for clinical trials containing all required measures (happy path validation).
The system must correctly compute scores when clinical_trials_service returns multiple trials with varying attributes (happy path batch validation).
The system must validate that each scored trial includes a composite score and a breakdown of contributing measures.
The system must handle missing optional measures by applying defined fallback or default logic without failing (exception path 1).
The system must fail gracefully or skip scoring when required minimum measures (<3) are not present, in accordance with schema rules (exception path 2).
The system must correctly integrate with clinical_trials_service outputs and accept its data structure without transformation errors.
The system must ensure that scoring logic does not mutate the original clinical trial input data during processing.
The system must validate that score outputs remain consistent regardless of input ordering of clinical trials.
The system must verify that extreme input values (e.g., highest phase, closest proximity) produce appropriately scaled high scores.
The system must verify that low-quality or unfavorable inputs (e.g., terminated status, distant location) produce appropriately reduced scores.
The system must ensure that floating point precision does not introduce material variance in composite scores across repeated runs.
